name: reqbridge-local-api
displayName: ReqBridge: Postman & Thunder Client to .http / OpenAPI + CSV Batch Runner
description: Lossless local migration from Postman v2.1, Thunder Client, Bruno (.bru), OpenAPI 3.1 & cURL to Git-native .http + OpenAPI 3.1, plus unlimited CSV batch runs and Staging-vs-Prod schema diff.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Migrate Postman, Thunder Client, Bruno, OpenAPI & cURL to Git-native `.http` locally (zero logins).
[Import Collection / OpenAPI](command:reqbridge.importCollection)
[Paste cURL Command](command:reqbridge.importCurl)
[Auto-Discover Thunder Client](command:reqbridge.autoDiscoverThunder)
[Activate Pro Key ($19/$29)](command:reqbridge.activateLicense)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with ReqBridge Local API
walkthroughs.description: Migrate Postman, Thunder Client, Bruno, OpenAPI 3.1, and cURL into Git-native .http files, run CSV batches, and diff staging vs. prod schemas locally.

steps.title: 1. Import Collections, OpenAPI, or cURL -> .http
steps.description:
Convert Postman v2.1, Thunder Client, Bruno (.bru), OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 (YAML/JSON), or cURL commands into `.http` + `.env.example` + OpenAPI 3.1.
[Import Collection](command:reqbridge.importCollection) or [Auto-Discover Thunder](command:reqbridge.autoDiscoverThunder)

media.altText: ReqBridge migration to .http, CSV batch runner, and schema diff walkthrough

steps.title: 2. Click CodeLens Send Request or Run CSV Batch
steps.description: Open any `.http` file and click `Send Request` or `Run CSV Batch` inline above any request to execute locally and emit JUnit XML + Markdown reports.

media.altText: ReqBridge CodeLens and CSV Batch Runner

steps.title: 3. Diff Staging vs Prod & Export Zero-Lock-In CI
steps.description: Catch breaking JSON type shifts and missing keys side-by-side before shipping, and export standalone `reqbridge-ci.mjs` + GitHub Actions YAML.

media.altText: ReqBridge Staging vs Prod Schema Diff
